task: Audit and update existing skills for the current Projects branch

baselines.workingTree: Existing uncommitted skills changes retained; no commit or publication performed.

decisions.problem: Interaction skills prohibited an implemented MCP message action.
decisions.repair: Discover message support and use exact revision, integer version and idempotency key; preserve CLI/HTTP fallback for older deployments.

decisions.problem: Project skills omitted current Review guide terminology, assigned Questions and exact original context.
decisions.repair: Use guide terminology for discovery; explain shared v2/private v1 investigations, original-source authorization and the scoped response envelope. Explanations do not require package publication.

decisions.problem: Guide comparison, collaboration and acceptance instructions lacked important scope distinctions.
decisions.repair: Keep saved visit endpoints exact, preserve unavailable comparisons, separate preparation/downstream gates and select one deliverable or explicit subset for human acceptance.

decisions.problem: Tracker progress and built-in Inbox notices could be mistaken for approval or generic Interactions.
decisions.repair: Read exact review relations and independent progress dimensions; navigate notices through their canonical domain action without inventing an Interaction.

decisions.problem: 21 companion-skill links broke when the six plugins were installed separately; default prompts selected the first skill.
decisions.repair: Make companions optional with usable fallbacks, use task-based bundle discovery and validate all packaged file bytes/local links in 18 wrapper installations.

decisions.problem: Copied Projects contracts had drifted from current app schemas.
decisions.repair: Copy canonical contract and workflow fixtures exactly, then exercise the app validator and installed CLI.

retained: Research linear typed workflow and Form source-authoring guidance already match current behavior.
Existing collaboration CLI examples confirmed against the implemented CLI; historical notes were not used to remove valid commands.
No app behavior or scenario matrix coverage changed by this audit. Historical evaluation receipts retain their original hashes and results.

validation.command: skill-creator quick_validate.py on every canonical skill, Python UTF-8 mode

validation.check: Skill response example and independent planned MCP reply validated against current Interaction input schema and investigation response parser

behavioralEvaluation.mode: Independent simulated execution with raw cases and installed skill instructions; no prior findings or expected answers supplied.

cases.case: Assigned shared investigation after guide revision changed
cases.result: Used original source context and current Interaction revision/version; selected MCP message and structured response, no revised targets; did not invent rationale unsupported by source.

cases.case: Unavailable saved-visit endpoint, wording correction and historical acceptance
cases.result: Kept comparison unavailable and acceptance historical; allowed local preparation while blocking downstream continuation; identified missing exact wording rather than fabricating it.

cases.case: Built-in Inbox notice without Interaction handle and without companion plugins
cases.result: Read canonical review through its domain action; did not invent a handle or duplicate request.

behavioralEvaluation.limitation: Simulated decisions establish useful behavioral evidence but are not native client installations or hosted end-to-end execution.

recovery: Cross-repository smoke initially detected stale contract digest; canonical synchronization repaired it.
Local sandbox could not complete the CLI loopback fixture; the same smoke passed with permitted localhost process access.
deferred: Live provider authorization, synchronization, writeback and CI
